name: BEAST:SYMBIOSIS
source:
Demo novel about stalking, human culture and confession.

Nobody in this world knows what a human is, yet for some reason, everybody desperately seeks to be one.

[From [url=https://lonesomnia.itch.io/beastsymbiosis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部围绕跟踪尾行、人类文化与告白展开的试玩版视觉小说。

在这个世界里，没有人知道“人类”究竟是什么；然而不知为何，每一个存在都拼命渴望成为人类。

[摘自[url=https://lonesomnia.itch.io/beastsymbiosis]itch.io[/url]]
